speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John? Will. From Great St Helen's. God give you joy of your day.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Will. I am at Aldermanbury. Say it, and then we will have the business, since I am awake.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not making you a speech before breakfast. Take the day by the item, if that is how you take it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: A wife. A full cradle. A house that does not smoke. A company eleven pound richer of a Thursday. That is the joy. I will not have it in a lump.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep it by the item. I did not call to write the company into my book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The court, then. Seven sharers' hose, and the hired men's, to be looked to before the old lord looks.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The boys' court suits are to be let out. Mistress Pope has let Arthur's hems down twice since Michaelmas, and there is no more hem. Nick's doublet wants easing at the chest, which Nick will not discuss.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Phillips says it holds if he's not startled. So nobody is to startle him. I've told the household.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will not startle him, and I will not ask him about the chest. He is not in my room this morning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow we choose the three plays in form. I want no surprises.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You said that in June, with a deposed king under your arm. God keep you.
